text:
anya_solutions: Heads-up  enterprise DP asked for a one-pager pilot SLA + onboarding checklist before invites. Key asks: residency, retention, incident comms, upgrade path.
mike_legal: Can do a short addendum. Need to confirm KMS/HSM and whether they expect raw request exports. Recommend opt-in raw logs only.
sam_ops: Ops: hosted pilot SLA = 99.5% realistic. 99.9% requires reserved capacity. Planned maint windows: Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. Sev1 ack within 1h, daily updates.
raj_engineering: Tech: KV purge within 72h on written request; convo logs deletion supported. Dashboards by default; raw logs = opt-in + data-handling addendum. Fallback = route to compatible variant or rate limit + notify.
zoe_pd: Let's split must-haves vs negotiables in invite. Must-haves: 99.5% pilot uptime, 30d retention default, 72h deletion, dashboard access, 1h Sev1 ack. Negotiables: raw logs, 99.9% SLA, longer retention tiers.
dp-bot: Reminder: use dp-invite-template v6 at https://redwood.internal/playbooks/dp-invite-v6
mike_legal: Draft snippet for review:
```
Pilot SLA addendum: Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide 99.5% monthly uptime for hosted pilot endpoints. Data retention: default 30 days; customer may request deletion of KV cache and conversational logs and Redwood will complete deletion within 72 hours of written request, subject to legal hold. Telemetry: aggregated dashboards provided; raw request logs available only with explicit consent and a separate data-handling addendum. Failover: Redwood may route requests to a compatible model variant or apply temporary rate limits during capacity or safety events and will notify partner with remediation timeline.
```
anya_solutions: Add one-line launch acceptance criteria: latency p95 < 500ms, quality regression <= 3% on partner eval (we'll include 5 sample prompts).
sam_ops: I'll confirm maintenance cadence and include weekly usage summary (no raw logs by default).
raj_engineering: I'll draft a short tech appendix about deletion flow and upgrade to dedicated pool (99.9% under separate agreement).
zoe_pd: Action list: mike = addendum redline + onboarding checklist (NDA, onboarding call, sample prompts, eval set, POC), sam = ops windows + incident cadence, raj = tech appendix, anya = partner talking points + 5 prompts. Aim to send invites next Tue. If partner insists on enterprise SOW, escalate. :white_check_mark:
